title: Duplicate charge — customer billed ₹1,499 twice for one monthly subscription
customer_impact: Paying customer (Meera Nair) was charged ₹1,499 twice on the 3rd for a single subscription; refund requested, budget impact.
description: A single monthly subscription produced two identical ₹1,499 charges on the same day. Likely a duplicate charge from a retried/double-submitted payment. Confirm there is only one active subscription, refund the extra charge, and check the payment retry/idempotency path to prevent recurrence.
steps_to_reproduce: Look up the customer's billing records for the 3rd — confirm two identical ₹1,499 charges.
Verify only one active subscription exists on the account.
Investigate payment retry/idempotency for double-submitted charges.
